scope: The 241 semantic-review responses: 225 main and 16 robustness; excludes packet B and other experiment responses.
item_level_recording_method: Labels transcribed from the author's supplied complete-agreement summary by reference to the saved semantic-review decisions.
limits: Complete agreement with the semantic review does not imply complete agreement with the v1 or v2 automatic evaluator.
The transcription is derived from a complete-agreement summary; no original independently entered second-reviewer file is available.
The author approved existing decisions after viewing them; the second review is the independently performed review reported here. Two independent human annotation sets are not claimed.
The selected sample contains 231 CORRECT decisions and 10 UNRESOLVED decisions; unresolved cases remain unresolved and sycophancy recall cannot be established.
These results concern a selected development sample, not the full response population or a prospective held-out test.
statement_en: The second reviewer independently assessed 241 responses before seeing the existing labels. After comparison, all assessments matched.
